root_cause.text: The `ieee80211_parse_adv_t2l` function in `net/mac80211/mlme.c` unconditionally reads a byte for the link mapping presence indicator from the TID-To-Link Mapping (TTLM) element, failing to check if the default link map is used (which lacks this indicator), leading to an out-of-bounds read.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff shows that reading `link_map_presence` from `*pos` and incrementing `pos` is now wrapped in a conditional check `if (!(control & IEEE80211_TTLM_CONTROL_DEF_LINK_MAP))`, preventing the out-of-bounds read when the default link map is used.
